violations.text: Allergen statement is lacking at the self-service station. Allergen statement must be added. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The door to the outside, located in the main entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 09/28/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the walk-in fans, and refrigeration/freezer units have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice was voluntarily disposed of (see attached disposal form). Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/17/2024

Self-serve baked goods, sandwiches, and chorizo breakfast super slices packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Self-serve food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. Per person in charge, establishment has ingredient information. Establishment made a sign notifying customers to inquire about label information during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/01/2024
